I am a postdoctoral researcher at the [Laboratoire Jacques-Louis Lions](https://www.ljll.fr/) (Sorbonne Université / CNRS) in Paris, working on phase space methods within the ERC Synergy project **[PSINumScat](https://psinumscat.com/)** (Phase-space-inspired Numerical Methods for High Frequency Wave Scattering).

My research is in **numerical analysis and scientific computing**. I work on a posteriori error estimation and adaptive algorithms for nonlinear partial differential equations, and on discretizations and iterative solvers for electromagnetic wave propagation. My work combines mathematical analysis with numerical implementation.

Before joining LJLL, I was a postdoc in the [POEMS team](https://poems.ensta.ip-paris.fr/) at ENSTA Paris, working with [Patrick Ciarlet](https://perso.ensta-paris.fr/~ciarlet/eng_index.html), [Axel Modave](https://www.axel.modave.eu/), and [Théophile Chaumont-Frelet](https://tchaumont.github.io/). I completed my PhD at Sorbonne Université and Inria Paris in the [SERENA team](https://team.inria.fr/serena/), supervised by [Martin Vohralík](https://who.rocq.inria.fr/Martin.Vohralik/) and [François Févotte](https://fevotte.net/), on adaptive finite element methods and solvers for nonlinear elliptic PDEs.
